plan.title: Not sure what to work on: get to know them, then 2–3 fitted ideas

transcript.text:
Hey, I'm ZOH! I'll help you get better at one thing with a small step each day. Text "stop" anytime, and you can change how I coach whenever you want, just tell me ("chill out", "push me harder"). What's your name, and what are you looking to work on?

• Put AI to work for you
• Read & learn more (books, ideas, any topic)
• Start something on the side
• Focus & get more done
• Speak & connect better
• Get fitter
• Eat better
• Sleep better
• Learn a fun skill (Rubik's cube, card trick, play a song, drawing)
• Not sure? Let's figure it out together
Good to meet you, Jordan, and not being sure is a fine place to start. Let's figure it out together. What do you do for work these days?
I'm a nurse, I work night shifts
Respect, Jordan. Night shifts take real stamina. What do you like to do with your free time when you're off?
cards and poker with the crew on breaks, and I used to read a lot before nights
Cards on breaks and a reading habit you miss, I like it. What's something you'd love to be better at, even if it feels random?
sleeping better would be huge honestly
Let's go, Jordan, sleep it is. On night shifts it's tricky, so what keeps you up or wrecks your sleep after a shift?
